native_services.contract: Return effective type objects with stable identity; qualify native all_types independently.
Test model metaclass inheritance; no Java reflection at runtime.
Preserve validator invocation subject and structural-feature diagnostic location.

completion_gates: All 11 selected checks generate Rust from resolved ASTs and are bound into native compilation.
checkOneType predicate is generated from its resolved helper body; no handwritten reconstruction.
Selected callers retain complete bodies and ordered diagnostics; no partial-method coverage.
Native type collection, metaclass and diagnostic bindings have independent focused controls.
Generated Rust agrees with actual Pilot for empty, single matching, single nonmatching and multiple-type cases.
Source mutation tests exercise helper and caller changes; unsupported constructs fail closed.
Remove superseded handwritten predicate evaluation for these seven callers.
Focused native tests pass with Java unavailable; reproducible generation checks pass.
excluded: General Java/EMF execution, mutation, reflection or dynamic dispatch
Whole-language specification compliance and full-corpus benchmarking
progress_policy: Report implemented check count / 11 only as a validator-count metric; do not represent it as time or overall gate completion. Helpers and qualification gates are mandatory and reported separately.
